from.place: evaluation equation of the base-change map

proof.text: By definition [def-pur-coefficient-base-change-hom], $c^F_{P,Q}$ is the closed transpose of $F(\mathrm{ev}_{P,Q})\circ\mu^{-1}_{H_A(P,Q),P}$ for the adjunction $-\otimes FP\dashv H_B(FP,-)$ of $S_B$ [def-coef-ringed-tensor-hom-model]. The counit identity of that adjunction gives $\mathrm{ev}_{FP,FQ}\circ(c^F_{P,Q}\otimes1)=F(\mathrm{ev}_{P,Q})\circ\mu^{-1}$; precomposing with $\mu$ gives the equation.

title: Evaluation equation of the coefficient base-change map
statement: Let $A,B$ be categories with internal-Hom bifunctors $H_A,H_B$ and closed tensor-Hom structures $S_A,S_B$ [def-coef-ringed-tensor-hom-model], $F:A\to B$ a functor and $\mu:F(X\otimes_AY)\xrightarrow{\sim}FX\otimes_BFY$ a natural isomorphism. For $P,Q\in A$ the coefficient base-change map $c^F_{P,Q}$ [def-pur-coefficient-base-change-hom] satisfies $$\mathrm{ev}_{FP,FQ}\circ(c^F_{P,Q}\otimes 1_{FP})\circ\mu_{H_A(P,Q),P}=F(\mathrm{ev}_{P,Q}).$$

lean.statement:
theorem baseChangeHom_evaluation
    {A : Type a} {B : Type c} [Category.{b} A] [Category.{d} B]
    {HA : Aᵒᵖ × A ⥤ A} {HB : Bᵒᵖ × B ⥤ B}
    (SA : CoefficientClosedStructure HA) (SB : CoefficientClosedStructure HB)
    (F : A ⥤ B) (μ : SA.tensor ⋙ F ≅ F.prod F ⋙ SB.tensor) (P Q : A) :
    μ.hom.app (HA.obj (op P, Q), P) ≫
      SB.tensor.map (Prod.mkHom (coefficientBaseChangeHom SA SB F μ P Q) (𝟙 _)) ≫
      SB.evaluation (F.obj P) (F.obj Q) = F.map (SA.evaluation P Q)
